title: Messenger & Instagram channels
tagline: Sol & Salt Swimwear — one assistant answering Messenger and Instagram DMs: faithful previews of both threads, a grounded collection and size guide, an MCP server over orders and returns, WebMCP page actions, and identified-customer order lookup.
channel_note: The real go-live hooks live in public/meta-config.json (the two fields the page actually reads at runtime): messengerPageId flips the CTA to https://m.me/<id> and instagramUsername to https://ig.me/m/<user>. The fields here are a documentation mirror only — set both together when the Meta lane connects a real Page and Instagram professional account to this tenant. 'also' lists the extra catalog row this one demo honestly covers.
